structured_output.what_is_happening: A 36-minute-old pumpswap token called "Tesla" (TSLA), launched through the meteora_virtual_curve launchpad, hit the activity trigger. In about 36 minutes it did $2.74M of volume against an $819K market cap and $188K of liquidity, and its price rose about 191%. It is the latest in a series of identical "Tesla/TSLA" clones launched over roughly the last 32 hours, using Tesla's real X handle and website as its "socials". At least 9 earlier clones now show $0 liquidity and no volume, which suggests they were rugged or abandoned after peaks of $1–4M market cap. Another TSLA clone (4nY1…), launched about 37 minutes earlier, has more liquidity ($345K) and far more volume ($6.2M in the last hour), so this token is not even the leading clone in the current cycle. GMGN flags 204 bundler wallets, 20 snipers and a 35-wallet insider trade network. It also shows 8,537 tokens tied to the "dev X account", which is really the Tesla handle being reused by spam launches. Buyers far outnumber sellers (1,685 vs 163), a pattern typical of bundled or bot-driven early buying before distribution.

narrative.description: Impersonation of Tesla, the famous brand. There is no project-specific story: no website or socials of its own, only a link to tesla.com and the @Tesla handle. The token is a vehicle for a repeated clone cycle, not a narrative.
narrative.why_spreading: Brand recognition plus serial relaunches. Traders chasing the TSLA ticker rotate into each new clone, possibly helped by a Tesla/Elon news item, but the attention belongs to the ticker, not to this contract.

token_connection.why_this_token: None beyond being a fresh relaunch of the same name. It has no official link to Tesla and nothing ties it to any real event.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 10 same-name TSLA tokens were created in the prior ~32h. Nine of them have $0 liquidity (peak market caps $1.1–4.3M). 4nY1fDwfG2xz… (created ~37 min earlier) has $345K liquidity and $6.2M volume in the last hour, outpacing this token.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN flags 204 bundler wallets, 20 snipers and 3 insider-tagged ('rat') wallets. There is a 35-wallet insider trade network. Top 10 holders own 94.9% (this may include the pool). There were 1,685 unique buyers vs 163 sellers. At least 9 earlier same-name clones went to zero liquidity. Five tokens reuse the same image. The 'dev X account' is linked to 8,537 launched tokens. There are no paid DexScreener promotions, but the whole setup looks like a serial launch-and-dump operation.
authenticity.uncertainty: No X data is available, so a real Tesla news catalyst could be adding organic retail flow. GMGN's creator hold rate (0.12%) and top-10 rate (3.4%) conflict with GeckoTerminal's 94.9% top-10 figure. The LP-unlocked warning also conflicts with lp_burn_ratio 1.0.

structural_risks: Serial clone pattern: earlier TSLA copies all ended at $0 liquidity
The liquidity lock status is contradictory: RugCheck warns that LP is unlocked and there are few LP providers
204 bundler wallets and a 35-wallet insider network could dump into the retail buying
A stronger same-ticker competitor is pulling flow away
Hourly turnover of 14.6× the market cap is churn, not accumulation; the 5-minute price change has already slowed to +6%

structured_output.counterargument: Tesla/TSLA is one of the most recognizable tickers there is. If a real catalyst is running (Tesla news, an Elon post, tokenized-stock hype), flow could concentrate in one clone and push it well past earlier peaks. Buyers still outnumber sellers about 1.6:1 in the last 5 minutes, the pool is deep ($188K), mint and freeze authority are renounced, and the LP may be burned (lp_burn_ratio 1.0). The token could run toward $2–5M before fading.
unknowns: Whether a real Tesla or Elon news event is driving the TSLA clone wave
Whether the LP is actually burned or can be pulled
Whether the bundler wallets still hold a large supply
How flow will split between this token and the 4nY1 clone
Whether promotion is happening in call channels or on X

structured_output.thesis: This is a brand-impersonation clone in a fast launch-and-rug series. The ticker's attention is spread across many copies, and the earlier ones all went to zero liquidity. Heavy bundler and insider activity, together with a stronger same-name competitor, make fading or a rug the likely outcome over the next few hours.
